description: Seed registry of physiological hypotheses, mathematical conventions, UI presets, canonical joint torque capacities, and citation verification statuses for Closed-Loop Null-Space Exploration (NSX).

conventions.statement: Canonical grip-midpoint orthonormal frame with u_hat along the shaft axis from grip midpoint toward clubhead, v_hat along the clubface normal projection orthogonal to u_hat, and w_hat = u_hat x v_hat.

parameters.tree_sign: +J_c^T lambda acts on the human kinematic tree; -lambda acts on the closing hand interface

conventions.statement: Canonical 6-D closure residual and Jacobian convention ordering linear translational rows before angular rotational rows in the grip-midpoint frame.
Diagonal capacity-normalized quadratic metric W_ii = 1 / tau_max_i^2 weighting each actuated joint torque by its declared static capacity bound.
Euclidean SI unit-scaled metric W = diag(1 / F_char^2, 1 / M_char^2) with characteristic force F_char = 100 N and characteristic moment M_char = 50 N*m.
Inverse generalized mass-matrix metric W = M(q)^{-1} used only as a declared mathematical norm projection P_{c,M^{-1}} tau, never labelled as Gauss's principle or true physiological torque.
Eight-facet inner/outer polyhedral approximation of circular Coulomb friction cones with worst-case radial error bound 1 - cos(pi/8) = 0.07612.

hypotheses.statement: Actuated joint torques remain within declared directional or bilateral static capacity bounds tau_min_i <= tau_i <= tau_max_i populated per canonical joint slot in NSX-04.

presets.name: envelope_only
presets.label: Static Feasible Envelopes Only (No Representative Selection)
presets.description: Computes per-frame upper and lower feasible bounds and Chebyshev margins under declared capacity and grip-cone hypotheses without selecting a single representative trajectory.

presets.name: capacity_min_effort
presets.label: Capacity-Normalized Minimum Quadratic Effort Representative
presets.description: Selects a prior-conditioned representative trajectory minimizing capacity-normalized quadratic joint effort within the static feasible envelope.

presets.name: smooth_capacity
presets.label: Rate-Smoothed Capacity-Normalized Effort Representative
presets.description: Couples admissible frames across time with a finite-difference torque-rate smoothness penalty and capacity-normalized quadratic effort.

citations.reference: Central second-difference variance propagation: Var((x_{k+1} - 2 x_k + x_{k-1}) / dt^2) = 6 * sigma^2 / dt^4

citations.reference: Boyd, S., & Vandenberghe, L. (2004). Convex Optimization. Cambridge University Press, §4.7 and §8.5.1.
